capture.py.txt: Acquisition script retained as executed in staging. Requires Python, urllib3 2.8.0 and truststore 0.10.4; staging paths are not a portable installation interface.
policy: Original-response id_ retrievals. Only 2018 page captures accepted. Supporting resources may resolve to other years; actual dates and redirect destinations are in manifest.json. Supplemental _2x candidates include inferred URLs, some of which were not archived. Failed responses are retained but not served as source content.
capture_dynamic.py.txt: Supplemental capture of image URLs observed during original-script replay in Chromium at device pixel ratios 1 and 2. Reads the ignored browser check report and reuses the staging capture script.
browser-discovered-resources.json: Original URLs derived from missing image requests during the full-page replay check; includes already-recorded unavailable retina candidates.
